name: Pandemonium
description: Capital of Hell and seat of the infernal council. Name is Milton's own coinage (literally 'all demons,' from Greek pan + daimon) -- entered the English language as a common noun for chaos/uproar directly from this poem. Built by Mulciber (architect, classically the fallen Vulcan/Hephaestus) from gold ore mined by Mammon's crews.
story_hooks: The infernal debate over war, ease, or corrupting mankind (Book II)
